name: Green Iguana
summary: Invasive arboreal lizard sunning itself on palm trees, garden walls, and hotel rooftops across urban Vice City and residential districts.
description: Green Iguanas are an invasive fixture of the Vice City urban landscape, mimicking the real-world South Florida iguana population. During rare in-game cold snaps, stunned iguanas can even be observed falling from high palm trees onto sidewalks and parked vehicles. They are passive toward players and scatter when approached.
habitat: Vice City palms, Ocean Beach luxury hotel gardens, Starfish Island walls

seo.title: Green Iguana: Urban Wildlife Profile
seo.description: Examine the Green Iguana population in GTA VI's Vice City. Urban habitats, palm tree behaviors, cold snap ambient events, and interactions.
